Q: kusapāta：việc rút thăm để xem tỳ khưu nào sẽ được nhận món cúng dường，trong trường hợp người đông vật ít hay giá trị các món chênh lệch nhau
K:
kusapāta：ကုသပါတ （ပု）
[ကုသ+ပါတ]
စာရေးတံ မဲချခြင်း။
R:
kusapāta：ကုသ-ပါတ （ပ）
သမန်းမြက်စာရေးတံချခြင်း။
DOP: 1 kusa m. , 1. [ S. kuśa], a kind of grass (with long pointed stalks, used at brahmanical religious ceremonies) ; Abh 602 (~o barihisaṃ dabbho); 1079; S I 49, 14* (~o yathā duggahīto hattham evānukantati) = Dhp 311 (Dhp-a III 484, 15 : ~o ti yaṃ kiñci tikhiṇadhāraṃ tiṇaṃ antamaso tālapaṇṇaṃ pi); A V 234, 13 (brāhmaṇā … allena gomayena paṭhaviṃ opuñjitvā haritehi ~ehi pattharitvā …); Th 27 (~aṃ poṭakilaṃ … urasā panudahissāmi) ≠ Ja VI 508, 1* ≠ Ap 505, 23 ; Ja V 407, 3* (kusāmayaṃ … atriccha kocchaṃ, -ā- mc ; 407, 27´ : usīrādimissakakusatiṇamayaṃ); — 2. [ cf S. kuśā], a piece of wood (or grass ? ) used as an identifying mark ; Abh 1079 (salākāyaṃ ~o); Vin I 299, 24 (tehi … bhikkhūhi taṃ cīvaraṃ bhājiyamāne apātite ~e añño bhikkhu āgacchati samako dātabbo bhāgo); III 58, 23 (aññataro bhikkhu saṅghassa cīvare bhājiyamāne theyyacitto ~aṃ saṅkāmetvā cīvaraṃ aggahesi; Sp 378, 10 foll. : yo hi bhikkhu ~aṃ pātetvā … attano koṭṭhāse patitaṃ kusadaṇḍakaṃ parassa koṭṭhāse pātetukāmo uddharati …); — °’- agga , n. [kusa + agga 1 ], the point of a blade of kusa grass; Vin IV 100, 21 (antamaso ~ena pi bhuttaṃ); It 68, 9* (pūtimacchaṃ ~ena yo naro upanayhati kusā pi pūti vāyanti) = Ja IV 435, 28* ; Ja V 468, 18* (~e udakam ādāya samudde udakaṃ mine, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se ~en’ udakam); — °’- aṭṭhaka , n. [ from kusa + aṭṭha 2 ], (food) for eight tickets ; Ap 416, 3 (Kassapassa bhagavato … ~am adās’ ahaṃ; Ap-a 487, 26 foll. : pakkhikabhatta-uposathikabhatta-dhurabhatta-salākabhatt-ādīsu kusapaṇṇavasena dātabbaṃ aṭṭhasalākabhattaṃ ahaṃ adāsin ti attho); — ° âvahāra , m. , theft by exchanging kusa markers ; Vin V 129, 18 (pañca avahārā theyyāvahāro pasayhāvahāro … ~o); Sp 378, 9 (kusaṃ saṅkāmetvā pana avaharaṇaṃ ~o ti vuccati); Spk II 145, 16 (~o) = It-a II 52, 3 ( Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr kusalāvahāro); — °’- āpāta , see sv kusapāta below ; — °- cīra , n. , a garment made of kusa grass ; Vin I 305, 31 (~aṃ nivāsetvā; Sp 272, 15 : kuse ganthitvā katacīraṃ); D I 167, 1 ; Ja VI 500, 12* (~āni dhārentī); — °- nāli , f. , kusa grass ;? Ja I 441, 19 (uyyāne ~-gacche devatā hutvā); — °- pāta , °’-āpāta, m. , the casting or dropping of markers (on shares of material to be distributed) ; Vin I 285, 35 (anujānāmi bhikkhave vikalake tosetvā ~aṃ kātun ti); III 55, 28* (kusāpāto, in uddāna); Sp 1124, 4 (evaṃ ṭhapitesu cīvarapaṭiviṃsesu kuso pātetabbo, tehi pi bhikkhūhi pi ~aṃ katvā bhājetabbaṃ).
NCP: masculine | kusapaata the casting or dropping of markers (on shares of material to be distributed) See also: kusāpāta, kusa
masculine | kusaapaata the casting or dropping of markers (on shares of material to be distributed) See also: kusapāta, kusa
